purpose: Establishes the specific contractual terms a Business Associate Agreement must contain to satisfy the Security Rule.
summary: The contract or other arrangement between a covered entity and a business associate must require the business associate to implement administrative, physical, and technical safeguards, ensure any subcontractors agree to the same restrictions, report security incidents, and make policies/procedures and PHI available to the Secretary of HHS as required.
expectedStatementElements: What specific safeguard obligations are written into the BAA template
How the BAA requires subcontractors to agree to the same restrictions
What the BAA requires regarding reporting security incidents back to the covered entity
How the BAA addresses termination and return/destruction of ePHI at contract end
evidenceExamples: Standard Business Associate Agreement template used by the organization
Clause language covering safeguards, subcontractor flow-down, and incident reporting
Contract termination/data return or destruction clause
Legal review sign-off on BAA template
commonGaps: BAA template is outdated and missing current required safeguard language
BAA doesn't specify a timeframe for reporting security incidents
No clear data return/destruction obligation at contract termination
interviewQuestions: Can you walk me through what your standard BAA template requires of business associates?
How does the BAA ensure subcontractors are held to the same safeguards?
What does the BAA say about reporting a security incident, and within what timeframe?
What happens to ePHI under the BAA once the contract ends?
